messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":5,"verses":[{"chapter":5,"verse":31,"text":"31 And notice that the figs are not in season, and understand.”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":32,"text":"32 Then Abimelech cried out in a loud voice, saying: “I bless you, God of heaven and earth, the Rest of the souls of the righteous in every place!”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":33,"text":"33 Then he said to the old man: “What month is this?”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":34,"text":"34 And he said: “Nisan, which is Abib.”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":35,"text":"35 And taking some of the figs, he gave them to the old man and said to him: “May God light your way to the city above, Jerusalem.”"}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 31,32,33,34,35 in this chapter.
